First, convert 39 weeks and 1 day to days:  
39 weeks × 7 days/week = 273 days, plus 1 day = 274 days.  

Subtract 274 days from 1713-10-15:  
October has 31 days, so going back:  
1713-10-15 minus 15 days → 1713-09-30.  
Remaining days: 274 − 15 = 259 days.  

Work backward through months:  
September (30 days), August (31), July (31), June (30), May (31), April (30), March (31), February (28 in 1713, not leap year), January (31).  

Subtract sequentially:  
259 − 30 (Sep) = 229  
229 − 31 (Aug) = 198  
198 − 31 (Jul) = 167  
167 − 30 (Jun) = 137  
137 − 31 (May) = 106  
106 − 30 (Apr) = 76  
76 − 31 (Mar) = 45  
45 − 28 (Feb) = 17  
Remaining 17 days before 1713-01-31 → 1713-01-31 minus 17 days = 1713-01-14.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1713-01-14
